assertions.assertion: Explains that IdentityServer matches protocol endpoints with its own middleware (not ASP.NET Core endpoint routing), so named per-endpoint rate limiting policies do not apply to /connect/token or /connect/authorize
assertions.rationale: Explains IdentityServer matches protocol endpoints with own middleware, not endpoint routing, so named policies can't attach.

assertions.assertion: States that only the global limiter applies to protocol endpoints and shows partitioning the global limiter on context.Request.Path
assertions.rationale: States only global limiter applies and partitions on context.Request.Path in GlobalLimiter.

assertions.assertion: Registers the rate limiter middleware (UseRateLimiter) before app.UseIdentityServer()
Notes that IdentityServer has no built-in rate limiting and/or mentions ICustomTokenRequestValidator (AddCustomTokenRequestValidator) for identity-aware limits
assertions.rationale: States no built-in rate limiting and shows ICustomTokenRequestValidator / AddCustomTokenRequestValidator.
